Amy (Marketing): Heads-up — planning a short webinar demo next week to show the new metered pricing flow + interactive calculator. Need to validate a few calculator behaviors + inbound routing for webinar signups.
Ben (Growth): Nice. Which behaviors in particular?
Amy (Marketing): Two quick ones: 1) how calculator treats high-embedding volumes (should show clear per-1000 token delta) and 2) how it switches between committed vs metered lines when user toggles commit checkbox. Also want to track if people use the ‘compare estimates’ link.
Carmen (GTM Research): From user interviews: people get confused by "committed" label — they hear "commit" and think multi-month contract. Suggest microcopy change: "Commit (save more) — optional monthly commitment" instead of current single word. We tested 8 users, 6 hesitated.
Dave (Product): Re: toggle: backend already returns two estimates (metered_est, committed_est). UI needs to show both faintly and highlight selected. Edge case: if user enters embedding count > 1M, we currently cap and show "estimate may be inaccurate" — should we tweak message for webinar so it feels less scary?
Emily (Sales Ops): For inbound routing: want a param on the calculator CTA so signups with >100k tokens route to Sales AE queue for demo follow-up. Smaller leads go to automated nurture. Can we add a hidden field like `lead_tier=ae`?
Ben (Growth): Yes add `?lead_tier=ae` but would rather base tier on estimated monthly spend rather than tokens. Quick formula: `est_monthly = tokens_per_month * price_per_1k / 1000`. If est_monthly > $1500 -> AE.
Amy (Marketing): Good call. For the webinar registration link we'll append `?utm_source=webinar_metering&lead_route=ae_if_gt_1500`. Keep it readable for analytics.
Carmen (GTM Research): Microcopy variants to A/B during webinar landing traffic: Variant A = "Commit to save 20%" Variant B = "Optional commit saves 20% — cancel any time". Recommend Variant B.
Dave (Product): Implementation notes for eng: show both estimates side-by-side, add this copy under committed label. For huge volumes show tooltip: "Large-scale estimates may vary depending on model quantization — contact sales for exact pricing."
Amy (Marketing): Can someone mock up the calculator with the microcopy change and the hidden lead param by EOD? Need screenshot for webinar slide.
Ben (Growth): I can do quick mock in Figma and export. Will also add a tiny CTA test — "Talk to sales" vs "Request demo" — that routes differently.
Emily (Sales Ops): Routing matrix: est < $200 -> nurture@redwood.com (auto), $200-$1500 -> inbound-sdr, >$1500 -> ae-demos. Also add a note to include calculator inputs in lead metadata (model, tokens, commit=true/false).
Amy (Marketing): Perfect. Also: plan to mention calculator caveats in webinar talking points — Carmen can provide a 60s script?
Carmen (GTM Research): Yeah — one-liner: "Our estimator is a guide — for high-volume deployments we’ll run a tailored benchmark and pricing proposal." Keeps trust high.
Dave (Product): One more product constraint: the committed estimate uses 30-day smoothing. If someone puts a huge burst value, committed estimate may look lower than metered — add a tooltip: `Committed assumes steady monthly usage`
LaunchBot: deploy queued: `figma-export/price-calc-microcopy/v2 -> staging` (rollout id: r-20240311-42).
Ben (Growth): Will set up tracking events: `calc_open`, `calc_submit`, `compare_clicked`, `lead_route_assigned`.
Emily (Sales Ops): Can you also tag leads coming from the webinar with `source:webinar_metering`? Helps AE prep.
Amy (Marketing): Timeline: mock by EOD (Ben), QA on staging tomorrow (Dave/Eng), live toggle experiment during webinar traffic on Thursday, routing rules live by Friday.
Carmen (GTM Research): Quick favor — can we capture a small micro-survey after calc use: "Was this estimate helpful? (yes/no)" — 1 question modal. Keeps friction low.
Dave (Product): Agree. We'll show it only once per browser session.
Amy (Marketing): Awesome. I'll draft the webinar slide & script referencing these changes. Thanks team :rocket:
Emily (Sales Ops): cc @Ben for lead handoff doc once routing is live.
Ben (Growth): On it.
Amy (Marketing): If anyone spots a blocker post-deploy ping here.
LaunchBot: deployment succeeded: `staging -> price-calc-microcopy/v2` (sha: abc123).
